body: LEAD: LAN/cloud operating modes should share one protocol and authoritative cloud relay. Default cloud mode: display and console independently open outbound wss://control.example.com/v1/socket; works across NAT/firewalls that permit HTTPS, no inbound ports. LAN optimization: after WSS pairing, optionally negotiate WebRTC data channel; keep WSS live for auth, signaling, commands fallback, and snapshot recovery. Never make mDNS/local IP/cleartext ws:// the only route: mobile secure-context and guest-Wi-Fi isolation make that brittle. WebTransport is server-client only, QUIC/UDP can be blocked (RFC 9114 section 3.1), and its browser API/spec remains preliminary; it can later replace WSS to the cloud, not replace peer pairing. Fully offline LAN mode materially expands scope: needs a trusted local relay/certificate provisioning and should be a separately declared product mode, not an automatic insecure downgrade.
summary: Unified cloud baseline with optional LAN fast path
